source.selection: exclude warmup; sort Mac draw_end-start descending; take first 5

definitions.input_id: Derived label run/input-count, not a protocol input ID.
definitions.first_response: First I420 successfully pulled by the main loop with the input visual counter; NOT guaranteed the absolute earliest frame completed by the producer.
definitions.first_response_id_reconstruction: One converter.pull per recorded pull_inner branch; a first-match timestamp inside the final capture span identifies that pull. Otherwise its ID stays null.
definitions.endpoint_frame: RWP frame visually matched at the measured Mac endpoint, not the last repaint before the next input.
definitions.mixed_ms: (Mac received - Mac write_end) - (Linux write_end - Linux input received). Contains both directions, bridge, serialization; no cross-host absolute subtraction.
definitions.two_clocks: Mac offsets start at SurfaceView input; Linux offsets start at Agent input receipt. Axes are unsynchronized and must not be overlaid.
definitions.deadline: Earliest eligible time reconstructed from last_capture and the max-FPS interval; NOT a hard send deadline or a global fixed tick.
definitions.remaining_wait: publish - max(eligible, final_sample_ready); observed time after both conditions, not automatically removable overhead.
